subject: Private-label marketplace listing — technical handoff and launch cadence
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@signalforge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@signalforge.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private-label listing — tech kickoff and requirements

Hi Ben / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. SignalForge is excited about a private-label listing on Redwood's partner storefront that bundles our data connector with your hosted API offering. We have two urgent asks before we lock dates for the joint announcement: 1) a technical checklist for listing (networking, endpoint URL patterns, auth flow for marketplace customers), and 2) a proposed go-live cadence with any gating items.

I attached a short doc with our connector spec and a proposed MAP (Market Access Plan). Can you confirm who on your side will own the tech handoff and what the earliest realistic launch window is?

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, SignalForge
Attachment: SignalForge_Connector_Spec.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@signalforge.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@signalforge.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private-label listing — tech kickoff and requirements

Elena — thanks for the spec and draft MAP.

Quick answers up front:
- Ownership: Olga will lead the technical integration on Redwood side and Karthik will own Marketplace product gating / billing mapping.
- Earliest launch: if dependencies are met, 6–8 weeks (targeting late April). If we need additional security attestation or a custom entitlement SKU, add 2–3 weeks.

I've attached our internal checklist and a short risk register. Olga — can you take point on the network/auth checklist and put together a short runbook? Karthik — can you confirm whether SignalForge requires a publisher SKU or a reseller arrangement for revenue share?

Next steps: propose a 60-minute technical kickoff next week (options below). Please reply with availability.

Options:
- Tue 2028-03-07 10:00 PT
- Wed 2028-03-08 14:00 PT
- Thu 2028-03-09 08:30 PT

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Partner GTM — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Internal_Launch_Risks.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@signalforge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private-label listing — tech kickoff and requirements

Hi all — copying a concise tech checklist so we can triage prior to the kickoff: 

1) Auth and entitlements
   - Marketplace customers must authenticate via Redwood OAuth with token exchange to SignalForge connector (we support JWT exchange).
   - Confirm whether SignalForge needs per-customer API keys or a multi-tenant connector with RBAC.

2) Network and routing
   - Public HTTPS endpoint for connector with TLS1.2+; optional mutual-TLS for enterprise customers.
   - Support for region-aware routing (US/EU) — SignalForge to confirm data residency needs.

3) Billing and SKU mapping
   - Will require a publisher SKU if SignalForge wants listing-level attribution; reseller arrangement otherwise.

4) Security evidence (if required)
   - SOC2 Type II attestation and data processing addendum (DPA) — provide copies if customers request.

5) Test plan
   - Staging listing, test customer signup flow, and observability hooks for token-level billing traces.

Olga — I'll draft a 30-minute runbook doc and upload. Elena/Tom — please confirm the per-customer auth model (API key vs multi-tenant) and whether SignalForge will require mutual-TLS.

Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@signalforge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@signalforge.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private-label listing — tech kickoff and requirements

Thanks Olga — quick clarifications from SignalForge engineering after reviewing the checklist: 

- We will support multi-tenant connector with per-customer scoping; no per-customer API keys initially.
- Data residency: we need EU routing for EU customers (can confirm a list of countries next week).
- We can enable mutual-TLS for larger enterprise customers but won't require it for GA.

Ben — the team can meet Tue 2028-03-07 10:00 PT for the kickoff. Attached is an updated MAP with timeline assumptions.

Tom Nguyen
Head of Engineering, SignalForge
Attachment: MAP_Draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@signalforge.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@signalforge.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private-label listing — tech kickoff and requirements

Great — confirming Tue 2028-03-07 10:00 PT for the technical kickoff (calendar invite sent).

Pre-kickoff asks (please have these ready):
- SignalForge: list of EU countries requiring data residency and any diagnostic endpoints for staging.
- SignalForge: example tenant onboarding flow (1–2 screenshots or short screencast).
- Redwood: staging listing URL and the runbook for token exchange.
- Redwood (Karthik): initial SKU proposal (publisher vs reseller) and high-level revshare bands for contract draft.

I'll coordinate follow-ups after the kickoff and will open a HubSpot activity (HUBSPOT-Deal-1198) with the landing milestones. If any major red flags appear before the meeting, flag them here so we can triage.

Talk Tuesday — thanks everyone.

Ben Carter
Director, Partner GTM
Redwood Inference
